project name: Project name. Becomes the case/report folder.
crest fillet radius R [mm]: Fluid-facing crest fillet radius (trough fillet is R + s).
foil gauge s [mm]: Full foil thickness t. The geometry, channel count and feasibility gate use t; the CFD shell (h_outerShell, T thickness) gets t/2, the half of the foil each channel owns.
channel length l [mm]: Wheel depth / channel length (Z extrusion, 1.5 layers/mm at refinement 1).
wheel_outer_diameter D_o [mm]: Wheel outer diameter. Sets the channel count N_ch and hence the per-channel mass flow (see mdot).
wheel_inner_diameter D_i [mm]: Wheel inner (hub) diameter, 0 <= D_i < D_o. Sets the channel count N_ch and hence the per-channel mass flow (see mdot).
stream mass flow rate mdot [kg/s]: Mass flow of ONE stream (hot or cold). It passes half the wheel face, i.e. N_ch/2 of the N_ch = pi(Do^2 - Di^2) / (4 b (a + s)) channels; the half-channel domain gets mdot / N_ch.
hot inlet temperature [K]: Gas temperature entering at the inlet patch (forward pass).
cold inlet temperature [K]: Gas temperature entering at the outlet patch (reverse pass).
mesh refinement r: Global refinement: every cell dimension scales as 1/r (1.0 = reference mesh).
end time [s]: Simulated time. The outputs are read over the last complete cycle.
number of processors: MPI ranks. 1 = serial Allrun; >1 = Allrun-parallel (decomposePar + makeFaMesh/solver -parallel). Capped at 128.
contact email: Job-done mail target. Ignored by the CLI.
